explanation: Try concatenation, multiplication and addition at each digit boundary. At completed expressions, evaluate multiplication before addition using an operand stack. A bound based on the remaining concatenated digits prunes some addition branches.
timeComplexity: O(n 3^n) worst-case time for n digits, including expression evaluation.
spaceComplexity: O(n) operands, operators and recursion space.
